segments.narration_text: Rohit and Ankush had been up all night, packed into a general coach train, barely awake by the time they got there. Udit strolled in fresh — he'd just come from a few kilometers away.
segments.caption_text: Two exhausted travellers, one very fresh local

segments.narration_text: First stop wasn't the hackathon — it was a photo with the IIM B sign, just enough to convince the group chat back home that they'd actually gotten in.
They'd arrived early, so before anything else, they just walked the campus.
Straight to the water tank next — the one every 3 Idiots fan recognizes on sight.
Then it was time to get to work. Heads down, laptops open, the hackathon clock started.
Somewhere past midnight, they snuck in a few photos on the famous butt chairs — before heading off to a hotel, since staying on campus overnight wasn't allowed.
segments.caption_text: Night shots on the butt chairs

segments.narration_text: Next morning, they were back, picking up right where they left off.
By the end, Rohit was completely gone — dozed off mid-hackathon, laptop still open in front of him.
They didn't end up winning. But before leaving, they took one last round of photos at the water tank, and said their goodbyes to IIM B.
